reason: PURE. The sachets caught my eye first: I already count capsules into a zip bag before trips, so 2 capsules sealed per day is exactly that done for me, and the bisglycinate has no citrate to wreck my stomach. The QR batch report on the box is a nice extra, but I would only try one box, since there are no reviews yet.
objection: No reviews and an unknown brand. A QR report is only worth something if I can actually open it and see a real lab name and numbers, and $1 a day for 200 mg is not cheap next to what I pay now.
would_change_my_mind: A handful of real verified reviews saying no stomach trouble, or a cheaper first-box price.
